integrity: The exact dodecagonal profile follows from the published symmetric-plane isosceles-pair reduction and an exhaustive symbolic comparison of all supporting facets on the reduced edge interval. The full boundary, active-facet switch, strict monotonicity, and equality orbit are proved by exact identities.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the real regular dodecagonal norm. The symmetric-plane reduction is previously known; the dodecagonal facet profile and optimum are the specialized calculation. No all-regular-polygon classification is claimed.
title: Exact \(\Omega\)-profile of the regular dodecagonal Banach plane
